title: C4OS Grill Question 007 - Workspace Descriptor Boundary

answer_key.Should C4OS still have portable workspac: Yes, explicit portable workspace files only; no automatic project-root folders
answer_key.If descriptor files exist, what can they: Project folder references and shareable workspace settings only

notes_or_corrections: You still should be able to load/save workspace files like in the mvp `workspace.c4os.json`. The main issue was how the MVP assigns project IDs (since project folder names are not unique). It relied on every project to have a `.c4os` folder so it can tag the project ID to that folder. I'm thinking a better way is to just create a map (id to folder) in a global config (or app level config). But if you have an even better idea let me know.

schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 007 - Workspace Descriptor Boundary

questions.label: Should C4OS still have portable workspace descriptor files?
questions.help: Recommended: yes, but only as explicit user-created/imported files, never automatic hidden project-root folders. Routine workspace/project registry state lives in the user config directory.
options: Yes, explicit portable workspace files only; no automatic project-root folders
No, all workspace/project config lives only in the user config directory
Hybrid: user config by default, optional explicit workspace file export/import

questions.label: If descriptor files exist, what can they contain?
questions.help: Recommended: references and shareable settings only. No secrets, transcripts, artifact archives, approval logs, or private operational state.
options: Project folder references and shareable workspace settings only
Full workspace config including plugin choices
Full portable archive including sessions and artifacts

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether descriptor files are needed for import/export, collaboration, backups, or should be deferred entirely.
